description: Presidential Secretariate - Call out all the members of the Armed Forces with effect from 22nd May 2021 for the Maintenance of Public Order in the areas
reasoning: This gazette content is an order issued by the President under the Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40), calling out armed forces for maintaining public order.
